newTopicsProposed.subject: Chemistry
newTopicsProposed.reason: A substantial cluster of records in ChemBook1 (roughly the first 14 records of this slice) test recall of glassware names/uses, hazard symbols, first-aid procedures, cleaning-mixture composition, and separation techniques (chromatography, distillation). None of the 24 canonical Chemistry topics (titrimetric analysis, qualitative analysis, etc.) cover general lab safety/technique/apparatus knowledge, so these skills have no good home in the existing list.

newTopicsProposed.subject: Chemistry
newTopicsProposed.reason: A large number of records test balancing nuclear/decay equations, identifying isotopes/isobars/isotones, mass defect and binding-energy calculations, and fission vs. fusion concepts. CHE_ATOMIC ('Atomic Structure and Quantum Numbers') covers electronic structure, not nuclear transformations, and Physics' PHY_NUCLEAR is a different subject; this Chemistry-subject nuclear-chemistry content needs its own topic.
